description.text: The fourth Diamond & Pearl set, released on 13 February 2008 with 106 cards and three theme decks, Endless Night, Eternal Time and Infinite Space. It brought in Darkrai beside Dialga and Palkia, the legendary Pokémon of the film The Rise of Darkrai, with four Pokémon LV.X among them Darkrai, Dialga, Palkia and Cresselia, and Pokémon Tools such as Amulet Coin and Leftovers came to the Diamond & Pearl series. Most of its cards are from the Japanese Moonlit Pursuit set; the rest of that pair waited for Majestic Dawn.
